title: Russian Artist And Political Dissident Robert ⁠Kuzovkov Shot Dead In Poland

title: José Roca Named Curator of 37th Ljubljana Biennale of Graphic Arts
summary: MGLC, the International Centre of Graphic Arts in Slovenia, has appointed Colombian curator José Roca curator of the 37th Ljubljana Biennale of Graphic Arts, to take place in 2027. title: 2026 Frieze Seoul Artist Award Goes to Yagwang
summary: Frieze has named Seoul-based collective Yagwang as the recipient of this year’s Frieze Seoul Artist Award. Now in its fourth year, like Frieze Seoul, the honor is presented annually to an emerging or midcareer Korean artist in support of new work.
